headline: We'll be back shortly
tagline: We're upgrading our core infrastructure to make the platform faster and more reliable. Thanks for bearing with us.
message: The database migration is running. The web panel is read-only and write requests to the API are paused until it finishes. No data is lost: queued requests will be processed as soon as we're back.
footer_text: Acme Cloud Ltd. · Example Street 1, London
